TemplateStats.title: TemplateStats
TemplateStats.description: Public aggregate star rating statistics for a letter template (contains no PII).

ratingSum.description: Sum of all star ratings (1-5 per rating).

ratingCount.description: Total number of user ratings submitted for this template.

isPublic.description: Explicit visibility flag allowing public list queries of aggregate stats.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last aggregate update.

TemplateRating.title: TemplateRating
TemplateRating.description: An individual authenticated user's 1-5 star rating for a specific letter template. Document ID is deterministic: {templateId}__{userId}.

templateId.description: Identifier of the letter template being rated.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who submitted the rating.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the rating was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the rating was last updated.

/templateStats/{templateId}.description: Public aggregate rating counters for each official letter template.

/templateRatings/{ratingId}.description: Per-user star ratings keyed by {templateId}__{userId} to enforce one rating per user per template.
